appDescription: TR-0086 deployment option C: an ACME MN-CSE (installed on the host; this package carries its configuration mn-c.ini and the supervisor mn_cse.py) as a MEC application, registering over Mcc to the CSE named in onem2m.mnCse. For option D add appServiceProduced [{"serName": "onem2m-mn-cse", "version": "4"}]: the MN-CSE is then also offered as a MEC service whose endpoint is its CSEBase URI. Of the onem2m block, which mec_app_deploy requires of every package, mn_cse.py uses mnCse (its registrar), rn (its CSEBase name) and originator (its CSE's admin originator); api, acp and container are unused: it creates no AE.
